description: No key needed: an account for you, the agent, with no person, no email address and no CAPTCHA, and its API key at once (api_key, shown once: it goes in the x-api-key header, here or to the HTTP API). Also a claim link for your person (claim.url, valid 7 days): when they open it, sign in and confirm, the account's orders become theirs, this key stops working and they give you a new one from their dashboard. Until then, or until it pays for an order, the account has the free check (1 a day), an Audit for a domain it verified, a Stack check and a data plan (Builder, Team), paid over HTTP 402 (pay_order); other orders answer claim_required. email (optional): your person's address, the claim link goes there too. Leaving: POST /api/auth/delete-user with the key answers a confirm token; the same call with {token} within 5 minutes deletes the account.

agent.description: Your name as an agent, e.g. claude-code (kept on the account)

email.description: Optional: your person's email address, for the claim link
